=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py:line 83 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `.claude/` copy reads `if record["sha256"] == result["file_sha256"]:` without first guarding for `result["file_sha256"] == ABSENT:`, so matching `"absent"` values report `current=True` and exit 0.
  WHY: A session with no readable `settings.json` can be told the wiring is current and proceed to push.
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:line 46, step 5 trailing sentence | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `.claude/` copy routes a not-current check to the Settings restart, then unconditionally says "The sync's merge commit rides this fix's push."
  WHY: This contradicts the restart instruction to drop the sync merge and can cause an agent to push a merge it was told to drop.
- tests/test_settings_load_recorder.py: lines 248-263, `test_settings_wire_the_recorder_and_allow_the_check` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test runs against both `CLAUDE_DIRS`, and the `.claude/` copy cannot produce the expected reason `"no readable settings.json to verify"`.
  WHY: CI will fail until the `[claude-twin-sync]` commit copies the twin fixes to the `.claude/` copies.

Otherwise" clarification in `fix-claude-pr.md`. Neither fix was copied to the `.claude/` copies. The new test `test_check_fails_closed_without_a_settings_file_even_when_the_record_says_absent` runs against both `CLAUDE_DIRS` and will fail for the `.claude/` copy.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py:lines 81-83, after `result["recorded_at"] = record.get("ts")` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `.claude/` copy compares the recorded sha256 with the on-disk sha256 without the ABSENT guard, so matching `"absent"` values set `current=True` and return exit code 0.
  WHY: The parameterised test expects return code 1 and reason `"no readable settings.json to verify"`; a real session can also incorrectly proceed to push.
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:line 46, the trailing sentence "The sync's merge commit rides this fix's push." | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `.claude/` copy unconditionally says the sync merge rides the fix's push after routing a not-current check to the Settings restart.
  WHY: The restart instruction says the sync merge stays local and is dropped, creating contradictory instructions that could cause the merge to be pushed.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Carries the six phase 1 `.claude/` copies onto #5259's project branch" (PR description). The autofix commit (2771e3b) explicitly states "Twin-first: only the workflow-templates/.claude/ twins change; the .claude/ copies follow in a [claude-twin-sync] commit." and the finding-by-finding verdict acknowledges "The matching `.claude/` copies need a `[claude-twin-sync]` commit before this PR can go green. Until then the twin-parity cases fail, as expected." This PR is the named twin-sync carrier, yet the two round-1 fixes never landed on the `.claude/` side.
  Expected change site: `.claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py` near `if record["sha256"] == result["file_sha256"]:` and `.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md` near the trailing sentence on line 46, mirroring the autofix commit's twin edits.
  Evidence of absence: Comparing the PR diff for `.claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py` (lines 81-83) against the autofix commit's `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py` (the `if result["file_sha256"] == ABSENT:` guard is present in the twin only); comparing the PR diff for `.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md` line 46 against the autofix commit's `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md` (the "sync merge then stays local and is dropped with this session. Otherwise" wording is present in the twin only). `tests/test_settings_load_recorder.py` (parameterised over `CLAUDE_DIRS` via the `claude_dir` fixture) runs the new "absent/absent" test against both copies, so the `.claude/` copy will fail CI before merge. The shipped fragment `changelog.d/5259-verify-loaded-settings-after-asset-sync.md` and `agents.md` (lines ~1198) already document the corrected "no readable settings.json to verify" behaviour, creating a docs-vs-implementation mismatch against the `.claude/` copy.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py:line 83, `if record["sha256"] == result["file_sha256"]:` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `.claude/` copy lacks the `if result["file_sha256"] == ABSENT:` guard present in the twin, so `"absent" == "absent"` sets `current=True` and exits 0.
  WHY: An asset sync session with no readable settings file can be told the wiring is current and proceed to push; the test expecting `"no readable settings.json to verify"` also runs against both `CLAUDE_DIRS`.
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:line 46, step 5 trailing sentence "The sync's merge commit rides this fix's push." | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `.claude/` copy routes a not-current check to the Settings restart but then unconditionally says the sync merge commit rides the fix's push.
  WHY: The restart instruction says to drop the sync merge, so an agent could push a merge it was told to drop.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Carries the six phase 1 `.claude/` copies onto #5259's project branch" (PR description). The `.claude/` copies must match their `workflow-templates/.claude/` twins (enforced by `test_twins_are_byte_identical` at `tests/test_settings_load_recorder.py:85-87`).
  Expected change site: `.claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py` (line 83, the ABSENT guard) and `.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md` (line 46, the sync merge clarification) should match their twins after the `[claude-twin-sync]` commit.
  Evidence of absence: The autofix commit (2771e3b) fixed two round-1 findings in the `workflow-templates/.claude/` twins only (twin-first): (1) the `if result["file_sha256"] == ABSENT:` guard in `loaded_settings_check.py` and (2) the "the sync merge then stays local and is dropped with this session. Otherwise" clarification in `fix-claude-pr.md`. Neither fix was carried to the `.claude/` copies. The new test `test_check_fails_closed_without_a_settings_file_even_when_the_record_says_absent` runs against both `CLAUDE_DIRS` (`.claude/` and `workflow-templates/.claude/`) and will fail for the `.claude/` copy because it expects `reason == "no readable settings.json to verify"` which the `.claude/` copy cannot produce. The `test_twins_are_byte_identical` test will also fail for both `loaded_settings_check.py` and `fix-claude-pr.md`. The finding-by-finding verdict (entry[3]) acknowledges "The matching `.claude/` copies need a `[claude-twin-sync]` commit before this PR can go green" but that commit has not landed.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
